title: Revolutionizing Healthcare: Seamless Access to Patient Information
lead: Secure, high-assurance identity for health professionals accessing sensitive patient records — in hospital or on home visits.
seoDescription: Discover how Scytáles helps healthcare professionals with secure and convenient mobile identity solutions.

sections.heading: The challenges
points: More people will need healthcare at home.
Patients can access healthcare without visiting hospitals.
Doctors need remote access to patient records.
Electronic health records contain sensitive information.
Home healthcare must keep patient data safe.

sections.heading: Our approach
sections.lead: The Derived Mobile ID NFC card lets health professionals reach a patient's electronic records by tapping their ID card on an NFC-enabled device. Level 4 digital certificates sit behind every authentication, so sensitive information is reachable 24/7 in the hospital and out on home visits without ever leaving safe hands.

sections.heading: Why choose Scytáles
rail: Health authorities already use the Scytáles Derived Mobile ID.
Authorised medical staff reach patient information from any device.
No physical smart card reader required.

demoText: See how our tailored solutions meet your needs with a personalized product demonstration.
